user.title: Connect to Dwellant
user.description: Sign in with your Dwellant portal account. Add more users later via the integration's Options.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Dwellant
reauth_confirm.description: Your Dwellant session expired or the password changed. Enter the email and new password.

imap.title: Package descriptions via email
imap.description: Optional: look up the concierge note for each collection code in your inbox. Gmail needs an App Password (not your normal password): 1) turn on 2-Step Verification at myaccount.google.com/signin/security, 2) create an app password at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords, 3) paste it below (spaces are fine, they are removed automatically). Server-side search only — just the matching emails are read. Leave the app password blank to skip.

data.imap_username: IMAP username = mailbox the Dwellant emails land in (set explicitly for aliases)
